poc_summary: Customer running evaluation of Redwood Dedicated to validate throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for conversational and search workloads. Goal: firm up reserved GPU count and SLA terms for a Q3 rollout. POC scope: load tests, soak tests, representative prompt mixes, model variant fallbacks and autoscaling boundaries.
representative_prompts: Chat: multi-turn support assistant with 8-12 tokens/h turn, context window 1024 tokens
Search: semantic document retrieval ranking candidate set of 50, average query text 40 tokens
Rerank: feed-forward reranking across top-10 results, heavy softmax ops
perf_targets: Throughput: sustain 120-160 RPS for 95% of test windows (128 token avg)
Latency: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms for chat generate (with reserved GPUs and batching)
Soak: 72-hour run with <1% error rate and no CPU/GPU OOMs
Availability: simulated failover with <2s retry times to fallback model variant
poc_plan: Phase 1 (baseline): 48h microbench - single model on two reserved nodes, synthetic traffic to determine kernel selection and batch sizing
Phase 2 (scale): ramp to target RPS over 6h windows, observe KV cache behavior and response tail latencies
Phase 3 (soak): 72h soak with mixed prompt mix and daily simulated network flaps
Phase 4 (SLA + ops): run canary + failover drills, exercise autoscaling and billing telemetry; produce GPU sizing workbook
